name: hyperliquid
description: Hyperliquid full-stack — one-transaction cross-chain deposits from seven chains, backend agent signing, all L1+user actions, copy-trade live engine, indexes, vaults, MCP tool server, ask-the-desk agent

layout.src/mod.py: Python orchestrator (serve/kill/status/forward, plus typed wrappers for every endpoint)
layout.src/api/: Rust REST API (axum, tokio) — backend agent signer, action signing, /exchange poster, live engine, MCP tool server
layout.src/api/src/mcp.rs: MCP tool registry + JSON-RPC dispatch — one schema for the mod fn surface and the MCP tool list
layout.src/agent.py: Claude agent whose only toolbox is this module's MCP server — read-only by default, write tools behind act=true + a token
layout.src/api/src/agent.rs: POST /ask (SSE) + GET /ask/status — spawns src/agent.py and streams its run
layout.src/app/: Next.js 14 app (copy-trade UI, indexes, vaults, live panel)
layout.src/api/src/deposit.rs: Cross-chain deposit rails — multicall balance scan across 7 chains, LI.FI routing straight into the Hyperliquid perps account

mcp.connect: http://localhost:3919/hyperliquid/mcp — endpoints, per-client config and the live tool list
mcp.transport: streamable-http (JSON-RPC 2.0, one message or batch per POST) + HTTP+SSE (GET /sse → POST /messages) + stdio (`hyperliquid-api --stdio`)
mcp.auth: optional — same Authorization: Bearer <mod protocol token> as the REST API; public tools work signed-out
mcp.docs: Every MCP tool fronts a mod-protocol fn from `fns` and executes as a loopback call to its REST route, so the auth gate applies unchanged. GET /mcp/schema publishes the tool → fn → route mapping.

agent.toolbox: this module's own MCP server over stdio — the agent holds no authority of its own
agent.modes: read-only by default; write tools need act=true and a mod protocol token
